title: Reference video analyzer
what_it_does: Measures a reference video (cuts, shot lengths, palette, motion energy) and writes analysis.json, GRAMMAR.md and a contact sheet.
when_to_use: In setup, for each video the person loves or dislikes: take its grammar (rhythm, cut rate), never its content, logo or exact palette.
notes: The source url is a placeholder (OWNER) until the repository is published. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
